profile.name: MPB VFL 激光器
profile.description: 由 MPB Communications 提供的串口控制激光器，可开关激光输出，在恒流或恒功率模式下设置激光二极管电流与输出功率，并读取发射功率、激光二极管和 TEC 状态；还支持 SHG（二次谐波）温度设定与调谐，适用于实验中的激光输出控制和运行状态监测。
profile.description_en: A serial-controlled laser from MPB Communications. It can enable or disable laser emission, operate in current-control or power-control mode, set laser diode current and output power, and read emission power plus laser diode and TEC status. It also supports SHG temperature setpoint control and SHG tuning for laboratory laser output control and health monitoring.
